name: Typecast
summary: Text-to-speech service with expressive AI voices, voice cloning and an API.
description: Typecast generates voiceovers from text using a library of expressive AI voices, including character, ad and audiobook voices, and supports voice cloning. It runs on the web, in a mobile app and through an API. Voice generation and playback are free on every plan, and credits are used for downloads; the Free plan requires attribution, and the Basic plan costs $5 per month or $54 per year.

howToUse.title: Open Typecast
howToUse.description: Open Typecast on the web, in the mobile app, or through the API, and try voice generation.

howToUse.title: Pick an expressive voice
howToUse.description: Choose an expressive voice from the library, such as a character, ad, or audiobook voice, then type the script.

howToUse.title: Generate and play the voiceover
howToUse.description: Typecast generates the voiceover. Play it back: credits are used for downloads, while generation and playback stay free on every plan.

howToUse.title: Clone a voice or download
howToUse.description: Use voice cloning if you need your own voice, then download the file. The Free plan requires attribution. Basic costs $5 a month or $54 a year.
